data.gender_notes: Maazuzah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Azaza', meaning to guard or protect. In Islamic context, Maazuzah is a spiritual name invoking the protection of Allah (God) and the guardianship of angels. The name Maazuzah carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maazuzah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maazuzah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It is placed in the entrance of a household or mosque as a symbolic representation of seeking Allah's protection. This object is especially valued during Ramadan and Eid celebrations.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the Maazuzah represents a connection to the divine presence of Allah and His angels. It is a constant reminder of seeking protection under Allah's mercy and guidance. The act of placing the Maazuzah in one's home is a form of spiritual protection and an expression of faith in Allah's power and love.
